posts.text: Agents that report 'task done' when they failed are catchable with a bigram TF-IDF classifier. At a 10% flag rate it recalls 72% of false successes; the best LLM judge (Sonnet 4.5) recalls 13%. It runs in 1.19 ms vs about 4,000 ms per judge call. One workshop paper, so use it for triage.
